record_title: A growing block of traced Rankin-Cohen brackets is linearly independent
provenance: Uniform asymptotic analysis of the explicit Fourier-coefficient estimate and determinant argument in Takloo-Bighash, together with the Rankin-Cohen spanning framework of Kayath--Lane--Neifeld--Ni--Xue.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint arXiv:2609.19649v1 was submitted on 17 September 2026, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. The discriminant D is fixed. The condition r log(2r)=o(sqrt(ell)) is sufficient and is not claimed optimal. The result remains far below the conjectural linear-size block. The proof uses the source coefficient estimate and Petersson framework as established inputs. For D=1 the resulting nonvanishing count is weaker than an existing linear lower bound; the new claim is the growing-block independence of the explicit Rankin-Cohen forms. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
